name: Sons of
text: Sons of is a title-opening formula of Irish names in English dress. It sometimes renders the Irish prefix Ui-, as in the name Ui Neill. The glossary entry points readers to that prefix for the fuller discussion.

attributes.attribute: occasional English rendering of the Irish prefix Uí-
